fixture.description: Digests-only witness offered over plain HTTP.
fixture.notice: Illustrative fixture for research/drafts/registration-record.md. Synthetic data and a public test-only key; it registers nothing and proves nothing.

object.name: Traceweave witness (illustrative)
object.description: Illustrative only; no such service exists. Receives the SHA-256 of a creator's DSSE signature, never content or fingerprints, and returns a signed, time-stamped witness statement. First to register is not first to create.

skills.name: Witness a registration digest
skills.description: Records that the authenticated caller presented this signature digest at the witness's receipt time, signs a witness statement and attaches time evidence. It does not register content, check authorship or check originality. First to register is not first to create.
